name: 96-child-gateway-route
command:
export KUBECONFIG=/tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig
kubectl create deployment gateway-test --image=nginx:1.28.0
kubectl expose deployment gateway-test --port=80
cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: GatewayClass
metadata:
  name: envoy-gateway
spec:
  controllerName: gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: training-gateway
  namespace: default
spec:
  gatewayClassName: envoy-gateway
  listeners:
  - name: http
    protocol: HTTP
    port: 80
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: gateway-test
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
  - name: training-gateway
  hostnames:
  - gateway-test.example.com
  rules:
  - backendRefs:
    - name: gateway-test
      port: 80
EOF
kubectl rollout status deployment/gateway-test --timeout=180s
stdout:
deployment.apps/gateway-test created
service/gateway-test exposed
gatewayclass.gateway.networking.k8s.io/envoy-gateway created
gateway.gateway.networking.k8s.io/training-gateway created
httproute.gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-test created
Waiting for deployment "gateway-test" rollout to finish: 0 of 1 updated replicas are available...
deployment "gateway-test" successfully rolled out
